deliverables: Upgrade Cardano mainnet protocol from version 10.0 to 11.0 while remaining in the Conway era.
Enable new Plutus primitives defined in CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138, and CIP-0153.
Make all Plutus built-in functions consistently available across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.
Add UPLC case expressions for Bool, Integer, and Data.
Promote or tighten ledger predicates and improve Cardano-node PPView mismatch diagnostics.
request.what: Initiate an intra-era Cardano mainnet hard fork to Protocol Version 11.0, named the van Rossem hard fork.

claims.claim: The proposal would upgrade Cardano mainnet to protocol version 11.0 through an intra-era hard fork while keeping the ledger in the Conway era.

The hard fork would introduce new Plutus primitives for modular exponentiation, dropList, BLS12-381 multi-scalar multiplication, arrays, and native Value handling, with linked CIP references for each primitive set.
The proposal says all Plutus built-in functions will become available across Plutus V1, V2, and V3, expanding capabilities for existing V1 and V2 scripts.
The proposal says native case expressions for Bool, Integer, and Data in UPLC will improve performance and produce cleaner script logic.

The proposal says testing reports demonstrate no behavioral regressions, complete specification-to-implementation conformance for new ledger rules, and correct operation of new Plutus features across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.

The proposal links a Cardano Node 11.0.1 performance report and says it shows no regressions for standard value, Plutus, and voting benchmarks, plus acceptable baseline performance for new Plutus primitives and case expressions.
The proposal says security audits were undertaken for Plutus BLS primitives and execution costs for all Plutus primitives.

The proposal says at least 85% of stake pools by active stake should have upgraded to a node version capable of protocol version 11 before ratification, and that this readiness must be verified by the Constitutional Committee and SPOs with Hard Fork Working Group readiness reports.

The proposal says it is consistent with all eight listed hard fork guardrails, while noting that none can be checked by the automated guardrails script and that HARDFORK-04 depends on stake pool upgrade status before ratification.

The proposal states that reversion is only possible in extreme circumstances through the CIP-0135 disaster recovery process, while Plutus primitive use could be disabled by changing companion cost model settings if issues are discovered.

summary: The document proposes a non-treasury hard fork to Cardano protocol version 11.0, centered on Plutus capability and performance changes, ledger-rule tightening, diagnostics, and readiness conditions including an 85% active-stake SPO upgrade threshold.
